product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates provider credentialing, verification, and ongoing network monitoring for healthcare organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: Verifiable describes its product as a credentialing and network-monitoring platform for healthcare organizations, supporting fast verifications and compliance: https://verifiable.com/press-releases/verifiable-inc-appoints-brook-west-as-president-to-spearhead-next-phase-of-growth.

pricing_page.notes: The inspected homepage navigation and footer offer contact and demo routes rather than a pricing link: https://verifiable.com/. The checked /pricing address returned a redirect-only response without readable plans. This supports false, with some uncertainty from the incomplete redirect response.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Humana and Grow Therapy appear in the homepage logo wall, and the company-issued announcement also names both as organizations it works with: https://verifiable.com/ and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verifiable-lands-27m-series-b-from-craft-ventures-to-automate-healthcare-provider-credentialing-301873076.html. | named_customers.0: Humana is named in the homepage customer-logo area. | named_customers.1: Grow Therapy is named in the homepage customer-logo area.

founded_year.notes: The Y Combinator company profile explicitly states that Verifiable was founded in 2019: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/verifiable.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains credentialing, compliance, webinar, and marketing content: https://verifiable.com/blog. The apparently technical credentialing-stack article is industry thought leadership rather than an explanation of Verifiable's implementation: https://verifiable.com/blog/from-legacy-to-scalable-engineering-the-ai-powered-credentialing-stack. Two qualifying engineer-authored build posts were not found.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation contains multiple sections, including release notes, getting started, common concepts, authentication, and provider endpoints: https://docs.discovery.verifiable.com/reference/current/overview/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable company job-board listing showed customer-success and solutions-engineering roles, with no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title: https://startup.jobs/company/verifiable. Confidence is limited because the official careers-page text omitted its role list and the third-party board may not be exhaustive.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor disclosure names Anthropic and Claude for automated code generation, evaluation, testing, and workflow assistance connected with Verifiable's platform and services: https://verifiable.com/legal/subprocessors. This does not establish that Claude powers every credentialing function.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Verifiable explicitly announces achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance, not an in-progress certification: https://verifiable.com/blog/verifiable-is-now-soc-2-certified. General discussion of HIPAA does not establish that Verifiable claims HIPAA compliance. | compliance_certs.0: Verifiable explicitly claims achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The primary funding announcement identifies Series B, matching the latest round in the funding profile: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verifiable-lands-27m-series-b-from-craft-ventures-to-automate-healthcare-provider-credentialing-301873076.html. | funding_date: The answer uses the primary announcement month, July 2023: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verifiable-lands-27m-series-b-from-craft-ventures-to-automate-healthcare-provider-credentialing-301873076.html. A secondary funding profile records June 2023 instead; no separate closing date was stated in the announcement, so the date discrepancy remains. | funding_amount_usd: The company-issued announcement states $27 million, and the funding profile identifies the same Series B as the latest recorded round: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verifiable-lands-27m-series-b-from-craft-ventures-to-automate-healthcare-provider-credentialing-301873076.html and https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5384c56fe4b05d85e2d43b86/verifiable#a:about.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding is the 2023 Series B, announced well before the 18-month window: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verifiable-lands-27m-series-b-from-craft-ventures-to-automate-healthcare-provider-credentialing-301873076.html. The June-versus-July source discrepancy does not affect this window assessment.
